    Carpet City

    Cyan gas tanks: shared boost refills (3–5s respawn). Glowing chevrons: reusable speed boosts. Yellow numbers: your remaining blocks. Red arrow: you. Coloured circles: rivals. Small squares: traffic. Everyone must collect each block once. First full set wins.

    Plan your route before starting.

    Options.

    Race setup

    Choose before starting. Your preferences are saved.

    Race Barriers: wider runoff where space allows, absorbing impacts with a bigger speed penalty. Grass and dirt still slow you down. Jump and bridge edges stay close. Carpet City has no circuit barriers.

    Independent settings, applied to you and CPU rivals before the race.

    Display & sound

    These can also be changed while paused.

    High detail adds surface textures, smoother scenery and extra vehicle details. Best on faster devices.

    Controller

    Connect a controller and press a button to wake it.

    Left stick / D-pad: steer · RT / R2: accelerate · LT / L2: brake & reverse
    A / Cross: boost · B / Circle: handbrake · Y / Triangle: recover
    LB / L1: camera · View / Share: map · Menu / Options: pause

    Menus: stick / D-pad to move, A / Cross to select, B / Circle to go back. Left / right changes a setting. Supports controllers recognised by your browser with a standard layout.
